// src/index.ts
import { type SourcePlugin } from "@family-agenda/source-sdk";
import { type MatrixInstance } from "./instance";
import { type MatrixPrograms } from "./services";
export type { MatrixInstance } from "./instance";
export { messengers } from "./messengers";
export type MatrixPluginOptions = {
    instance?: MatrixInstance | string;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    programs?: MatrixPrograms;
    startTimeoutMs?: number;
};
export declare function createMatrixPlugin(options?: MatrixPluginOptions): SourcePlugin;
declare const _default: SourcePlugin;
export default _default;
export declare function servicesFromEnvironment(programs: MatrixPrograms, instanceFile: string): {
    programs: MatrixPrograms;
    databaseUrl: string;
    dataDirectory: string;
    instanceFile: string;
    host: string;
    serverName: string;
    ports: {
        synapse: number;
        bridges: {
            whatsapp: number;
        };
    };
    database: {
        host: string;
        port: number;
        name: string;
        user: string;
    };
};

    readonly requests: string[];

    private position;

    ghost(phone: string): string;
    get bot(): string;
    createRoom(name: string, ghosts?: Record<string, string>, options?: {
        direct?: boolean;

    jidOf(roomId: string): string;
    rename(roomId: string, name: string, at: Date): void;
    leave(roomId: string, userId: string): void;
    invite(roomId: string, userId: string, inviter?: string): void;
    addMember(roomId: string, userId: string): void;
    isMember(roomId: string, userId: string): boolean;
    send(roomId: string, sender: string, content: Record<string, unknown>, at: Date): string;
    text(roomId: string, sender: string, body: string, at: Date): string;
    upload(bytes: Uint8Array): string;
    redact(roomId: string, eventId: string, at: Date): string;
    replaySync(userId: string, responses: SyncResponse[]): void;
    setLogin(userId: string, stateEvent: string | null, reason?: string): void;
    awaitsScan(userId: string): boolean;
    scanQr(userId: string): void;
    refreshQr(userId: string): void;
    private append;
    private roomOf;
    private userOf;
    private qrStep;
    private messagesChunk;
    private stateOf;
    private sync;
    private syncRoomFor;

    private roomSync;

    private routeOf;

    private handleRegisterCheck;
    private handleClientRoute;
    private handleRoomRoute;

// src/instance.ts
export type MatrixInstance = {
    homeserver: {
        url: string;
        serverName: string;
        registrationSharedSecret: string;
    };
    bridges: Record<string, {
        url: string;
        provisioningSecret: string;
    }>;
};
export declare const defaultInstanceFile = "/var/lib/family-agenda/matrix/instance.json";
export declare function instanceReader(source: MatrixInstance | string): () => Promise<MatrixInstance | null>;
// src/messengers.ts
import type { PluginText } from "@family-agenda/source-sdk";
export type Messenger = {
    id: string;
    displayName: PluginText;
    description: PluginText;
    riskNotice?: PluginText;
    botLocalpart: string;
    ghostPrefix: string;
    qrLoginFlow: string;
    scanHint: PluginText;
    attributeValue: string;
};
export declare const messengers: Messenger[];
export declare function messengerOf(id: unknown): Messenger | undefined;
